text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm-hmm-hmmm♪
What should I cook for "Diner Bono" tomorrow, I wonder~?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Mmh... Mmmgh...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Biko-chan, why the serious look? Is something troubling you??

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: No, I'm not troubled! I'm just researching a recipe!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: They had that "Carrotman" special episode the other day, right? I want to recreate the dish Carrotman served back then!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ! In that case, leave it to Diner Bono♪ I'll give you a hand~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Heheh, thanks! ...But I'm okay this time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'll do it on my own! This is something I want to pull off with my own power of justice!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I... see. ...Yeah, do your best!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright... The ingredients are all set! Time to cook~! Yeahhh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: (I ended up sneaking in to watch...! But, but, I want to help if anything goes wrong!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Guhhh... It's burning so fast...!! Uh, add more oil, and...—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: (Biko-chan, you can do it, you can do it...! But that's dangerous, turn down the heat already~~!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I... It's done...!! Absolute perfection!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: (Whoa, incredible! Biko-chan really made it all by herself!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...I see. She doesn't need my help anymore, huh...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —Bono?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Eep! Ah, B-Biko-chan!! Um, well, this is...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Great timing!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bono—won't you try this fried rice?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I worked super hard recreating this recipe because I wanted you to eat it, Bono!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah, but it's not just an imitation! It's a nutrition-packed Biko Special!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You're always teaching me which ingredients have what kind of nutrients, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Simmered komatsuna and thick fried tofu"! Both are super rich in calcium♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Biko-chan, you don't like milk, right? Getting cramps easily might be from a lack of calcium. So let's replenish your nutrition with this♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: So I packed this fried rice full of nutritious stuff too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Thanks for everything, Bono! Keep staying full of energy and stick by my side, alright!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ! I see... Oh, so that was it...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... Ehehe, thank *you* so much. I'm suuuper happy—it's totally buono!
One afternoon, I spotted Hishi Akebono and Biko Pegasus.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah! Someone's hunched over over there! Sounds like a job for a hero, I'm on it!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Fufu, Biko-chan is full of energy today too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: She'll keep growing up healthy and strong, and become a splendid hero.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —It's a little lonely... but that's not all it is.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Growing up big and buono alongside the feelings I shared with her—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's such a warm and wonderfully happy thing♪
